'''Artesian''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] found on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and controlled by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].
